headline: 25 notable citizen-written complaints this week in Austin

items.text: 2 massive potholes in the right hand southbound lane at/before 7-11 that are now a few inches deep… tore my undercarriage off and several drivers clearly avoided the area better than I did. Please send help! This is a very busy street and this is dangerous / may cause cars to swerve onto the sidewalk.

*** Floor UNIT 26A** Two large dogs have been kept crated outside on their front patio 24/7 for months, exposed to extreme heat. We’ve observed feces/urine around the crates and rarely see the owners caring for them. Multiple reports have been made; please escalate and conduct an urgent welfare check. Have seen female owner yelling at dogs.

Pile of discarded tire, trash and miscellaneous junk left on the public street/right-of-way. The items appear to have been abandoned and are obstructing the public area. Requesting removal and cleanup. I moved it out of the street and said it aside. Thank you!!

Pile of discarded trash and miscellaneous junk left on the public street/right-of-way. The items appear to have been abandoned and are obstructing the public area. Requesting removal and cleanup. I moved it out of the street and said it aside. Thank you!!

Parker Ln./ Oltorf St. constructions:

I have several questions, does the city of Austin know what's up with all these unfinished construction projects that are taking so long all over the city? It’s been like this since August of last year. Does the city respect its residents' time? Is the city hiring traffic engineers who know what they're doing? And does the city give out contracts to the right

Car blocking ROW. Can’t get wheelchair around car on sidewalk in front of San Gines. I’ve asked since January to have proper signs added for ROW. I spoke to the restaurant and the city. 5 different departments. They don’t care or don’t have oversight. I’m just asking for the sidewalks to not be blocked. It’s unreal. Please enforce now that school is back.

Coyotes have burrowed an extensive den in an eroding bank right underneath a utility pole in our backyard. They are frequently in our yard which is a danger to our children, Need help deterring them to abandon this den and ensure pole doesn’t erode and fall over.

loose Milling needs to be picked. 
there is a return to school opening event occurring on August 17th 2026 for the City of Austin. 
Just the street needs to be swept. 
please do not sweep over the new markings and new speed hump. only the street needs to be swept before Monday August 17th 2026... thank you in advance...

Completed. RITIS data shows from last week the average LOS was 50s+ for the westbound from 5am-5:45am. The LOS from 5:45am-6am shows to be around 30s. Would adjusting the schedule for the AM bump plan to at least 5:30am work?
items.address: E Us 290 Hwy Svrd Wb & Johnny Morris Rd, Austin

items.text: Person shooting up, left needles behind, can someone clean these up and also please close the camp behind the IBC bank where all of these drug users live? This is is a Dailey occurrence here.

Victory Lap - Violating Decibel Level (again).   They’ve “received citations” several times, but keep playing loud music.  Also, I noticed the previous complaint against them where the officer said that they asked each bar if they received calls directly (all said no, of course) and that they “investigate” all noise violations within 24 hours.  Make it make sense.  I agree that APD needs to take t

Animal abuse. This dog is stranded in the heat all day everyday on the balcony COVERED in poop and pee. It is at the Bridge of Loyola apartments. The apartment is facing Johnny Morris. You can’t miss it. It is the bottom floor first apartment closest to the new construction development. We pass by everyday and he is always there. Please save this baby. Thank you

Traffic/Sightline Hazard: The truck is parked approximately 20 feet from an intersection. Because of its size, it completely obstructs line-of-sight for vehicles at the perpendicular stop sign, forcing drivers to nose dangerously into oncoming traffic to see around it (violating TTC § 545.302 regarding intersection proximity and traffic obstructions). Truck hasn’t moved in over 3 months and appear

Completed. I have a video but it seems too large to attach. How can I get this to you? 
From 290 feeder road light turns green going under the bridge toward AMAT at 18 seconds, light at bridge exit is green for a 17 seconds, turns red at 35 seconds, then green again at 47 seconds. Based on video. Cannot upload it, it is too large. Uploading screenshots instead.

A Mazda is illegally parked in a designated tour bus loading zone.  It is blocking tour buses from being able to park and load/unload customers.  This causes a backup of traffic. This vehicle needs to be towed. This car needs to be towed.  Thanks.

No photos, but we need to address the trash at the old Strait Music location at Lamar and Ben White. Also, across the street, at the same intersection at Ben White and Lamar (south west side) there is currently a ton of trash where the homeless guy hangs out.
items.address: 2428 W Ben White Blvd Svrd WB, Austin

items.text: There is a large amount of dirt and rocks in the right hand turning lane on the intersection of Ed Bluestein and FM 969, on the SB lane/NE side of the intersection. It is causing traction issues in the turn and cars are swerving to avoid it, creating a very unsafe traffic environment. It appears to have been recently spilled by a truck hauling dirt.
items.address: 4900 Ed Bluestein Blvd Svrd NB, Austin

items.text: 3rd street and Walter Seaholm drive. Green tarps need to come down. Most are flapping in the wind and Bushes are growing over them and it’s becoming a graffiti wall. Also a bunch of broken glass near corner of 3rd and Walter seaholm dr across from TJ’s. This area needs to be cleaned up badly.

Requesting clean up of beautiful murals on both sides of Lamar near 5th Street downtown. Very talented artists did them years ago but now many have been vandalized. Also weeds and often trash along the sidewalks. I’m sure funds are tight but the murals deserve protection.

The light at Scofield farms and Parmer Ln is broken. Heading north on scofield farms, the light will not turn green for going straight for several cycles. I am repeatedly late to events every morning because of this. Please fix this asap.

This is a 70ft Hackberry Tree that has already had very large limbs fall and impact my roof. I believe it needs to be trimmed back, being in Austin’s drainage easement, or removed completely. If it is not people are likely to be hurt.
please help...more cars are parking in the tour bus lane...causing issues for the tour buses. safety issue!!

I hear neighbors dog like it is trapped in a bathroom or closet Poor dog is whimpering crying in pain! Been all night 3am and I still hear it is barking whimpering howling. Cant even slepp its in so much distress

Victory Lap music is over the decibel allowance (again).  DJ this time.   Takes cops too long to go over and they turn it down when the lookout sees cop cars. 

Also, just because it’s a weekend doesn’t mean the cops should allow bars to keep consistently breaking the law.

Concern regarding animals in Apt. 4208. I repeatedly hear a dog yelping, sometimes accompanied by sounds resembling stomping or running. I have documented incidents on 6/16 (stomping and dog yelping 3x), 6/26 (dog yelping 2x), 8/4 (dog yelping and running sounds), and 8/12 (possible cat meowing, followed by running/chasing sounds and dog yelping). These are only some incidents. I hear similar soun

Every day there is a group of vagrants that congregates here and harasses passerby. They camp there, throw garbage everywhere, shoot up drugs, block the trail, and harass passerby. Yesterday one was wielding a giant metal pipe banging it on things as people tried to avoid him. We have to do something about this.

An individual experiencing homelessness is regularly stationed at this intersection for extended periods and solicits pedestrians as they pass. His close proximity to pedestrian traffic and persistent presence at the corner make the intersection uncomfortable to navigate, and there is also a strong urine odor around the area.

Pickup is parked facing the wrong direction against traffic (left side to the curb) and is actively obstructing the active travel lane on a narrow two-way residential street. The truck is sitting directly in the roadway instead of using the available dedicated paved parking spaces provided nearby, restricting safe two-way traffic flow

The bike parkway on Airport Blvd. between E 46th St. and E 51st St. is impassable on the southbound side due to overgrown vegetation. This stretch of bike parkway is frequently blocked from vegetation/debris and seems to be generally neglected.

There is glass & other debris on the roadway at intersection of Tamarron Blvd  & Walsh Tarlton Ln that is causing traffic to divert around it and therefore creating a safety hazard. This is a follow up to request #26-00255985. The hazard still exists.

Large deceased tree from adjacent multifamily property at 6905 E Riverside Dr fell on 8/7/26, striking two residences and multiple fences at 2005 Maxwell Ln. Property management was notified of the hazardous tree before it fell but has not removed it and is now unresponsive. Tree remains in place and is a safety hazard. Requesting City assistance.

This is a screenshot of Riverside Dr and where the two traffic signal lights that have slow timing are located (circled in red). One of the lights is at the intersection of Riverside Dr and Congress Ave, while the other one is a light on Riverside right before it more east.

I this signal skips the yellow arrow phase (showed possible by the Google Maps image posted) I’m here every morning around 6:45 am and there’s a red arrow for a good majority of the cycle while there is no opposing traffic- it then makes you sit through a long cycle of red arrow and a another full cycle of red lights then gives you a very short green arrow window. At this time of day there are man

The left turn signal when traveling south on Wayne riddel takes forever to turn green. I’m often sitting there with no traffic on 1626 for an extended period and have seen several from our neighborhood start running this light due to the time to change

Lights on Burnet between 183 and Braker Ln are not synchronized, it can take up to 10 minutes to drive this stretch since it seems very light turns red as soon as you get to it. This seems to be related to the construction on the street, but it is causing significant traffic

At two locations in 4600 Mueller Blvd SBWC, Parking Enforcement requesting addition of bike icon pavement markings where delineator curbs flatten to flush pavement, inviting encroachment over bike lane by parked vehicles,
trash collection needed - this isnt being collected unless requests are submitted. please assign to a regular collection schedule as this is a heavily used trailer.

There’s a large water leak, into the fort branch creek, at mlk and bundy hill.  If you park at bundy hill, and look north from the mlk pedestrian bridge, you’ll see water flowing from the wooded lot on the NW side of mlk/creek.
items.address: 5016 E Martin Luther King Jr Blvd, Austin

items.text: Noise ordinance is to stop playing music at 10 pm. I don’t understand how they continue to play loud music with the bass blasting at now 11 pm. I’ve now been awake because of them for an hour it’s extremely frustrating.
Mattress on the STREET. Please send to Transportation Public Works to remove, this is their responsibility to maintain the public street free of debris. Thank you.
